summary: Mogres are a level 32 Slayer ogre-type monster assigned by Mazchna and Vannaka; there is no dedicated task page, the Slayer task list links Mogres to Slayer task/Ogres and mogres also count for an Ogres task. On land they live only at Mudskipper Point (fairy ring AIQ), where you must Use a fishing explosive on an Ominous Fishing Spot from a few tiles away to lure one ashore; they can be safespotted from the fairy ring, the STASH unit to the west or along the shoreline, and the Rimmington church altar just north restores prayer for Protect from Melee. Since Sailing, swimming mogres in the Ardent Ocean can be killed with a ship cannon without explosives or the miniquest, but 32 Slayer is still required. Bring a tinderbox and logs to cook the raw fish they drop.
styleNotes: Land mogres attack with crush, are aggressive, max hit 8, have a 20% elemental weakness to earth spells and are immune to poison and venom (poisonresistance = 100); sea mogres are level 54 and not aggressive.

usefulItems: Tinderbox and logs (cook dropped raw fish)

Halberd or ranged weapon for the safespots
Adamant keel or better on your boat for sea mogres
alternatives: Mogre (sea) in the Ardent Ocean (Mudskipper Sound, Strait of Khazard, Kharazi Strait) killed from a boat cannon (43.5 xp)

summary: Molanisks are a level 39 Slayer task assigned only by Vannaka (50 combat, Death to the Dorgeshuun completed). They are found only in the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon (fairy ring AJQ), stuck to cave walls; you must ring a Slayer bell within 3 tiles to pull one off, after which it becomes aggressive to you. Bring a light source because the dungeon is dark, and expect very little damage despite their level. They are weak to crush and magic and can be safespotted on a large rock down the path south of the fairy ring, where two spawns are close together.

summary: Moss giants are a low-level task from Vannaka (40 combat) and Krystilia (Wilderness only) with zero defence against every style and a 50% weakness to fire spells, so any style works and most spots have safespots. Varrock Sewers is a strong pick because it is multicombat, cannonable, safespottable and right next to Bryophyta's lair; Catacombs of Kourend giants also drop dark totem pieces but no cannon is allowed there. summary: Nechryael (80 Slayer, 85 combat, Priest in Peril to be assigned) are melee demons that summon up to two death spawns whose typeless hits ignore Protect from Melee and single-combat rules, so bring food or use blood spells. The wiki's fastest option is bursting or barraging the 14 greater nechryael in the Catacombs of Kourend with a goading potion to draw aggression, since they are not aggressive; for melee it recommends the Iorwerth Dungeon (the nechryael there drop crystal shards) with a demonbane weapon such as Emberlight or Arclight. Normal nechryael in the Slayer Tower are safespottable using the tables and buckets, and the Charred Dungeon (60 Sailing) is a multicombat, cannonable spot for normal nechryael. Krystilia tasks must be done in the task-only Wilderness Slayer Cave; bring a one-click teleport such as a royal seed pod.
styleNotes: Demon attribute (demonbane weapons very effective); crush attackers, not aggressive, no poison or cannon immunity; the superior Nechryarch is poison/venom immune and summons three chaotic death spawns (melee, magic, ranged) only if it can reach you.
usefulItems: Goading potion (or darts/knives/Dinh's bulwark) to lure since they are not aggressive

summary: Red dragons must be unlocked with Seeing red (50 points) and need partial Dragon Slayer I for the anti-dragon shield; Konar, Nieve and Duradel assign 30-80. Adult and brutal variants use melee plus dragonfire (max 50), so bring an anti-dragon or dragonfire shield and antifire potion, or use Protect from Magic; baby red dragons have no dragonfire and count too. Brimhaven Dungeon has 16 adults plus 12 babies, allows a cannon, has a safespot by the pipe shortcut and drops noted hides with the elite Karamja diary; Forthos Dungeon has 6 with an altar but no cannon; after Dragon Slayer II the three in the Myths' Guild basement are very close to a bank. Brutal red dragons in the Catacombs are a slow alternative that can drop a draconic visage.
styleNotes: Chromatic dragons weak to ranged, magic and stab (Baby red dragon page); 50% elemental weakness to water; slash plus dragonfire attackers, aggressive; brutal reds also use Magic and long-range dragonfire and are poison/venom immune; none are cannon immune.
requiredItems: Dragonfire protection for adult/brutal dragons: anti-dragon shield, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward or ancient wyvern shield, and/or antifire potions (not needed for baby dragons)
usefulItems: Super antifire potion (full protection, frees the shield slot)
Prayer potions for Protect from Magic / Protect from Melee
Dwarf multicannon (Brimhaven, Corsair Cove, Charred Dungeon)
